subject: Seat-tilt proposal + feature bundling options for Medinova
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lowe <emma.lowe@medinova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Seat-tilt proposal + feature bundling options for Medinova

Emma —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our conversation, I attached a concise proposal (Medinova_Proposal_v3.pdf) that lays out two paths: a modular bundle (pick & pay features) and a bundled plan (all-in feature suite with seat pooling). A few items I want to call out up-front:

- Seat-tilt: temporary seat pooling to absorb short-term spikes without permanently increasing licensed seats.
- Downgrade path: proration rules + feature hold for paused seats (we can lock advanced analytics for paused seats so you don’t pay for capabilities you aren’t using).
- Pilot option: 30-day pilot at a reduced metered rate to validate throughput and latency on your typical workloads.

Can you confirm: 1) who on procurement should I send the SOW to, and 2) whether a 6- or 12-month commit is preferred (that affects proposed discounting)?

I copied Ben and Neha for pricing and approvals. I’ll hold off on formal SOW until we have procurement contact.

Regards,

Michael Grant
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com | (415) 555-0148

From: Emma Lowe <emma.lowe@medinova.com>

Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 10:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Seat-tilt proposal + feature bundling options for Medinova

Thanks Michael —

Quick clarifications from our side before procurement proceeds:

- We like the seat-tilt idea but need clear guardrails: max tilt capacity, how long seats can remain tilted, and the expected cost delta when tilt is exhausted.
- Downgrade path: if tomorrow our usage drops 40%, do we get pro-rata return of committed credits or are seats locked for the term?
- For features: can advanced analytics be toggled per-seat or only account-wide? We’re aiming to offer advanced analytics to a subgroup of teams, not everyone.

Procurement (cc’d) — please advise if we need a redline-ready SOW or a shorter SOW + addendum to proceed with a pilot.

Best,
Emma Lowe
Director of Platform Engineering | Medinova Health
emma.lowe@medinova.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Seat-tilt proposal + feature bundling options for Medinova

Michael / Neha —

Notes for the reply to Emma and procurement:

- Tilt guardrails: default max tilt pool = 25% of committed seats, extendable to 40% as a paid addon. Tilt duration: up to 60 days continuous per seat in a 12-month window (we can shorten to 30 days for a 6-month commit).
- Cost delta: when tilt is active, usage is billed at metered token rate + 15% surcharge; once tilt is consumed, bursts are billed at on-demand rate.
- Downgrade proration: prorate remaining committed dollars and convert to account credits, redeemable against future usage or seat top-ups. We avoid forced seat release mid-term unless both parties agree.
- Feature gating: advanced analytics can be entitlements per seat (toggleable). We'll require a 2-week QA window to disable/enable without data loss.

Attached is a quick pricing workbook with sample scenarios (pricing_calc_medinova.xlsx). For negotiation leverage: offer a 10% one-time onboarding credit for 6-month commit; 18% onboarding + 5% recurring discount for 12 months. Procurement usually responds well to a limited-time credit + clear downgrade proration.

Ben
Sr. Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: pricing_calc_medinova.xlsx (scenario workbook)

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lowe <emma.lowe@medinova.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@medinova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Seat-tilt proposal + feature bundling options for Medinova

Emma / Procurement —

Thanks for the clear questions. TL;DR: seat-tilt and per-seat feature gating are both supported; below are the exact terms we recommend based on your use case. If you’re comfortable, I’ll follow up with an SOW + DocuSign link.

1) Tilt guardrails
- Default: up to 25% of committed seats can be tilted concurrently.
- Optional: increase to 40% (paid addon).
- Tilt duration: 60 days max per tilted seat in any rolling 12-month period for 12-month commits; 30 days max for 6-month commits.
- Billing when tilted: metered token rate + 15% tilt surcharge until pool is exhausted; then on-demand overage rates apply.

2) Downgrade / proration
- If usage drops we prorate committed dollars on remaining term and issue account credits. Credits may be applied to future Redwood usage or used for feature add-ons.
- We will not force immediate seat deactivation mid-term unless mutually agreed; instead, seats can be marked "paused" with feature hold for up to the tilt duration.

3) Feature bundling & per-seat entitlements
- Advanced analytics and model explainability can be toggled per seat. A short QA window (up to 2 weeks) is required to flip entitlements safely.

4) Pricing and discounts
- 30-day pilot: reduced metered rate (50% of listed on-demand), non-recurring tech validation.
- Commit discount options: 6-month commit = 10% onboarding credit; 12-month commit = 18% onboarding credit + 5% recurring discount.

Next steps I propose:
- Procurement confirms preferred commit length and procurement contact for SOW.
- I’ll send a concise SOW that includes the tilt params and pilot terms; Ben has the pricing workbook attached for reference.

If procurement wants a different split (e.g., larger onboarding credit in exchange for a modest price uplift), we can model that quickly.

—
Michael Grant
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com | (415) 555-0148

Attachment: Medinova_Proposal_v3.pdf (updated), pricing_calc_medinova.xlsx (Ben's scenarios)
